# Is a CD or Treasury ladder worth it after tax?

> Free CD and Treasury ladder calculator: build a ladder from the rates you type, see after-tax yield per rung with the state-tax exemption, and compare it with the longest CD or rolling short if rates move. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
